requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that an exact specialty match returns a score of 1.0.
The system must execute unit tests validating that a partial specialty match returns a score strictly between 0 and 1.
The system must execute unit tests validating that no specialty match returns a score of 0.
The system must validate through unit tests that multiple provider specialties produce the highest applicable match score.
The system must validate through unit tests that ambiguous user queries still return a valid score within the range [0,1].
The system must ensure unit tests verify deterministic scoring where identical inputs always produce identical outputs.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that evaluate_care_facade returns specialty score fields defined in the schema.
The system must validate via integration tests that specialty scoring is invoked during provider evaluation requests.
The system must validate via integration tests that matched NUCC codes are included in the facade response.
The system must ensure integration tests confirm consistency between standalone scoring logic output and facade output.
The system must validate that scoring logic handles empty or null specialty input without throwing unhandled exceptions.
The system must validate that scoring logic handles providers with no taxonomy codes by returning a score of 0.
The system must include LLM-assisted test cases that semantically vary specialty queries (e.g., synonyms) and confirm consistent scoring classification.
The system must include LLM-generated paraphrase test inputs to validate robustness of partial match scoring.
The system must ensure LLM-generated edge case inputs (ambiguous or multi-intent queries) do not break scoring logic.
The system must validate via tests that score outputs always remain within the normalized range of 0 to 1 inclusive.
The system must ensure all tests follow existing test patterns and structure defined in the backend tests directory.
